profiles.label: Competitive
profiles.description: Turns the driver's latency reduction on while the game runs, Radeon Anti-Lag or NVIDIA Low Latency Mode at Ultra, to cut the time between your input and the frame it produces.

profiles.label: Smoothness
profiles.description: Caps the game's frame rate at the stream's, so the game does not render frames the stream drops and its frames arrive evenly.

profiles.label: Quality
profiles.description: Turns anisotropic filtering on. On Radeon the driver also enhances the game's own anti-aliasing; on NVIDIA it filters at 16x with high-quality texture filtering. Costs GPU time, so it suits games that run well under the stream's frame rate target.

profiles.label: Custom
profiles.description: The driver settings listed for this game, and nothing else.
